grain.url: response url when saved, fallback requested_url; preserve query, remove fragment

post_cap_evidence.note: Investigator chosen trial cap, not a published quota

baseline.note: 1597/326 is a partial observed lower bound; 57 untimed calls in the first six collectors remain unassigned, and the left window predates initial timestamp instrumentation

comparison.inference: A lower recent request load coexists with no common503 in this later observation, consistent with but not proof of rolling/resource throttling or recovery. Site/route mix, elapsed time, cooldown and implementation also changed.

collection_run_reconciliation.envelope_note: Whole batch00010 counter is allocated exactly; partial batch00009 missing dispatches may be inside or outside the window. This is not a bound on all environment traffic or a quota counter.

limitations: This is one fully elapsed60minute interval, not a complete account of every network request; missing dispatch capture is reconciled against collector counters.
0.25/0.28/0.35 rates coexist inside this window; .35RPS was only a cap and ordinary503 caused child rate reductions. It was not a controlled constant-rate experiment.
No24worker/3RPS pre-cap calls appear in this window. Old cached robots attachments keep their original times and cannot be relocated into it.
Earlier failures occurred at0.25RPS too, so neither this one successful window nor1/hour arithmetic proves a universally safe rate or provider quota.
The initial baseline is left-truncated and57collector calls lack matching timestamps; missing times and origins are not imputed.
Response Date, provider arrival logs, hidden counters/limits and uninstrumented environment traffic are unavailable for causal attribution.
Conditional siteTLS/termination or ordinary503 responses are distinct from sharedInvalidargument503; noIR-acceptance conclusion is derived from transport errors.
Source bytes were read after the fixed boundary; later saved results of earlier dispatches may be included, while starts after the boundary are excluded.
